definition: Contravene means to go against or violate a rule, law, or agreement.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word contravene. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know contravene should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: Painting your fence purple would contravene the association's bylaws, the letter warned, citing page nine.
To bend a rule is much milder than to contravene it — stretched, the rule still holds; contravened, it is broken.
Defy goes further than contravene: a rule can be contravened quietly, even by accident, but defiance is loud, deliberate, and aimed straight at the authority behind the rule.

Violate is the everyday word for breaking a rule or law, blunt and morally loaded. Contravene is its cool, formal counterpart — the vocabulary of inspectors and official findings — and it carries no charge of intent: an act can contravene a regulation entirely by accident.

Breach breaks the terms of an agreement while it stands — a contract, a treaty, a lease. Contravene is wider: conduct measured against any rule, law, or agreement and found to collide with it. Every breach of contract contravenes something; plenty of contraventions involve no agreement at all.

Infringe trespasses on a rule or a right, often bit by bit — each small step edging further over the line. Contravene names a conduct-versus-rule collision, whole and assessable in one finding. A fence infringes on a neighbor's land inch by inch; a banned pesticide contravenes the regulation outright.

The city's new sound ordinance was written for nightclubs, but the letter that arrived at the sculpture park cited it anyway.
The park's beloved wind-harp installation, an inspector had found, would contravene the ordinance whenever gusts pushed its tones past sixty decibels.
No one accused the artist of bad intent; she had installed the harp two years before the rule existed.
That was the odd comfort of the inspector's word: it described a collision between conduct and regulation, and said nothing about blame.
The park trimmed the tallest strings, the readings fell, and the file was closed without a single hard feeling.
